The '''JC series''' was a [[Pilot/Legends|pilot]] [[Droid/Legends|droid]] model produced by [[Industrial Automaton/Legends|Industrial Automaton]] and derived from the [[V-series pilot droid]]. Unlike other [[Pilot droid/Legends|pilot droids]], they were programmed to be competitors and pushed [[Starship/Legends|starships]] to the maximum.<ref name="ETU" />
